framework_intro: Pillar → Sub-domain → Skill. Click a sub-domain to see its skills.
framework_empty: The capability framework is not loaded on this database.
empty_domains_hint: Start by creating your first pillar — or load the starter framework.
confirm_delete_domain: Delete this pillar? This also affects every skill in it.
subdomains_intro: Competency elements grouped under each pillar. Skills are placed in a sub-domain.
confirm_delete_subdomain: Delete sub-domain « {{name}} »? (only allowed when it has no active skills)
empty_skills_hint: Get started by creating your first skill.
pick_subdomain_hint: Pick a sub-domain above to list its skills, or open the “Framework” tab to see the whole tree with its counts.
field_levels_title: What each level means for this skill
field_levels_hint: Leave empty to use the category's anchor. One observable behaviour per level, 600 characters at most.
sq_intro: Descriptions and level anchors help each person understand what they rate. Proposals are visible to employees only once approved.
sq_count_used: {{n}} skill(s) used by at least one role
sq_count_few: {{n}} with fewer than 5 level anchors of their own
sq_import_hint: Columns: Pillar, Sub-Domain, Skill, Category, Description FR, Description EN, Niveau 0 FR … Niveau 4 FR, Level 0 EN … Level 4 EN. An empty cell never erases a text. The import never adds or removes a skill.
sq_has_current: A description already exists: approving replaces it for each proposed language.
sq_bulk_confirm: I confirm approving the ticked proposals: their texts will become visible to employees.
sq_todo_intro: Skills used by at least one role, with no description or fewer than 5 level anchors of their own, sorted by the number of employees concerned.
sq_todo_none: Every skill in use has a description and its 5 anchors.
sq_starter_done: Supplied proposals: {{inserted}} loaded, {{described}} already described, {{existing}} already proposed, {{unmatched}} not recognised.
sq_approved: Proposal approved: the description is now visible.
sq_import_done: Import finished: {{rows}} row(s) read, {{updated}} skill(s) updated, {{unmatched}} not recognised, {{errors}} error(s).
sq_err_generic: The operation did not complete. Try again or check the system log.
sq_err_proposal_empty: A proposal must contain at least one text.
sq_err_proposal_not_open: This proposal has already been handled.
sq_err_reason_required: Give the reason for the rejection.
sq_err_anchor_too_long: A level anchor cannot exceed 600 characters.
sq_err_starter_file_missing: The supplied proposals file is missing from this installation.
sq_err_starter_file_invalid: The supplied proposals file cannot be read.
sq_err_confirm_required: Tick the confirmation before approving a selection.
sq_err_workbook_unreadable: The file is not a readable Excel workbook.
sq_err_workbook_missing_columns: Pillar and Skill columns not found in the first row.
lib_intro: Start from a ready-made sector pack or import skills from ESCO instead of writing the framework from scratch. Every import shows a dry run first and never changes what already exists.
lib_packs_intro: Each pack holds pillars, sub-domains, skills with French and English descriptions, role families and sample roles with required levels. The packs are original content released under CC0: adapt them freely once loaded.
lib_packs_empty_text: No pack file was found in db/postgres/seed-data/packs/.
lib_packs_note: Loading matches every item by name (French or English): anything that already exists is reused and left unchanged, so loading the same pack twice creates nothing.
lib_report_title: Dry run: nothing has been written yet
lib_report_intro: Here is what importing "{{title}}" would do. Check it, then confirm to write it.
lib_report_esco_truncated: {{n}} more skills in the ticked groups are above the limit and will not be imported this time. Import them in a later run.
lib_report_nothing_new: Nothing new: everything in this import is already in the framework.
lib_done: Import complete: {{created}} items created, including {{skills}} skills and {{roles}} roles. Existing items were left unchanged.
lib_err_generic: The import could not be completed. Nothing was changed.
lib_err_confirm: Confirm the import from the dry run screen.
lib_esco_attribution_note: ESCO data is © European Union and licensed under CC BY 4.0. This attribution must remain visible wherever imported ESCO skills are used; it is recorded in the audit log of every ESCO import.
lib_esco_upload_intro: Download the ESCO v1.x skills classification in CSV format from the ESCO portal, then upload these files, separately or together in one .zip:
lib_esco_file_relations: the hierarchy of the skills pillar (required)
lib_esco_upload_hint: The files are read on the server and kept for a few hours only, for this session. Nothing is imported until you confirm a dry run.
lib_esco_groups_title: Choose the skill groups to import
lib_esco_loaded: {{skills}} skills in {{groups}} groups, read from {{files}}. Tick the groups you need; each import is capped.
lib_esco_no_french: No French file was uploaded: skills will only have English descriptions.
lib_esco_no_groups_text: The files were read but contain no released skill.
lib_esco_count_over: %n% skills selected: only the first %cap% will be imported
lib_esco_discarded: The uploaded ESCO files were discarded.
lib_esco_err_missing: Missing ESCO file(s): {{files}}. Upload skills_en.csv, skillGroups_en.csv and broaderRelationsSkillPillar_en.csv.
lib_esco_err_zip: The .zip file was refused: it is damaged, too large once unpacked, or uses an unsupported format.
lib_esco_err_csv: A CSV file could not be read ({{detail}}).
lib_esco_err_columns: A CSV file does not have the expected ESCO columns ({{detail}}).
lib_esco_err_empty: The files contain no released ESCO skill.
lib_esco_err_upload: The upload was refused: only .csv or .zip files, at most 5 files, each within the size limit.
lib_esco_err_expired: The uploaded ESCO files are no longer available. Upload them again.
lib_history_empty: No import from the library yet.
